<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Insurance Company" processRef="claim-process" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="claim-process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="claim-lanes">
      <bpmn:lane id="handler" name="Claims handler">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>searchReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>compileFile</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>calculateEstimate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>createActionPlan</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="manager" name="Claims manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>negotiate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>informClaimant</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Claim accident reported" />
    <bpmn:task id="searchReport" name="Search the Police Report in the Police Report database" />
    <bpmn:task id="compileFile" name="Put the Police Report and the Claim Documentation in a file" />
    <bpmn:task id="calculateEstimate" name="Calculate the initial claim estimate" />
    <bpmn:task id="createActionPlan" name="Create the Action Plan based on the Action Plan Checklist" />
    <bpmn:task id="negotiate" name="Negotiate a settlement on the claim estimate" />
    <bpmn:task id="informClaimant" name="Inform the claimant of the outcome" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="Claim process ended" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="searchReport" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="searchReport" targetRef="compileFile" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="compileFile" targetRef="calculateEstimate" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="calculateEstimate" targetRef="createActionPlan" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="createActionPlan" targetRef="negotiate" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="negotiate" targetRef="informClaimant" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="informClaimant" targetRef="end" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
